Illustrative sequence. No real model or benchmark is running.

Capability firstTest every changeRestore on failureReduce to purpose

One capability.
A continuous test.

Inspired by awake brain surgery: keep checking the function while changing the structure. Every accepted reduction is an experiment with an explicit criterion.

01Choose the skill.

Start with your pretrained model and tasks that represent the capability you need.

02Remove a candidate.

The agent modifies or removes model components, then evaluates the resulting model.

03Keep or restore.

Compare the evaluation with your acceptance criterion. A damaging change is reversed.

Pass → keepFail → restore

04Specialize further.

Repeat the search toward your size, memory, latency or hardware constraints.

You define
what must survive.

Coding, mathematical reasoning, classification, or another target task. The evaluation you choose tells the agent which reductions are acceptable.

LOBBOT aims to find the structure necessary for your use case, instead of trying to preserve every capability equally.

# Illustrative input contract
model: your_pretrained_model
preserve:
  capability: code
  benchmark: your_task_suite
  acceptance: your_quality_criterion
constraints:
  memory: your_budget
  latency: your_target
  hardware: your_device

# modify → evaluate → keep / restore

This describes the product concept. It is not an implemented SDK, executable command, or public API.

Make the model fit
the job.

The search starts with a function to preserve. Optional deployment constraints define where the specialized model should ultimately run.

Size & memory

Provide a target model size or memory budget. Resource savings must be measured on the resulting model.

Latency & hardware

Define your target device and latency requirements. A smaller structure alone does not prove faster inference.

Local & edge

Explore specialized models for constrained environments. Compatibility depends on the actual model, runtime and hardware.

LOBBOT is a hackathon project. This page presents the proposed mechanism. No measured compression ratio, benchmark retention, inference speed or supported model list has been published here.

Less model.
Same mission.

A model shaped around the capability you need.
A reduction process guided by evidence.
